name: Hydro Power Plant
description: Vibrations measured on the inside of a hydro power plant. The three subsets show a small window of a small accident, which occurred during maintenance operations.

name: Engine Multiple Runs
description: Vibrations acquired from an engine, showing multiple runs (with and without damage). The subsets highlight the difference if noise is applied.

name: Engine Run To Failure
description: Vibrations acquired from the bearing of an engine in a run-to-failure setting.

name: Hidden Gravitational Waves
description: Synthetic dataset highlighting hidden patterns in noise.

name: Sorting Machine Debris Impact
description: This dataset features measurements acquired from a sorting machine that sorts cobbles by their size. To achieve this, a sieve is utilized, that naturally wears out, causing larger cobbles to fall through. The goal is to measure the impact of cobbles on a metal plate beneath the sieve. The dataset shows vibrations of the metal plate, with and without anomalies.
